rules.requirement: Each owner deducts border from its own inset once; child artwork may have a separate explicitly owned border.
Neither slot: L each edge; leading only: trailing 2L; trailing only: leading 2L; both: 0.
Label compensation is independent of density.
L = control labelEdge / 2.
Inline edge budget = .5u, reduced from 1u; independent of label slider.
D=max(B,Iparent); Ichild=max(B,Icontrol-D); preserve slot.
Requested inset zero yields gap zero and child radius zero, even with nonzero border.
Gap equals requested inset, not border-clamped effective inset.
Child radius = max(0,parentRadius-D), capped at child half-height; zero-inset override wins.
Radius = 1u, independent of curvature selector.
Interior cells own half a gutter per side; first/last outside edges own a full inset.
Do not override nested component density.
Use collection inset/gap 1u/2u/3u, row separation .5u and container curvature. Never apply composite subtraction or exposed copy margins.
Keyboard-only focus indication; implementation must retain meaningful focus for text inputs.
Do not add divider lines where backgrounds already indicate boundaries.
Border 0px; composite inset 0u; control and container curvature Soft.
Prefix/suffix/selector use chip geometry and real chip label wrappers, not badge geometry.
Parent and each adornment minimum inline size equal their own height.
Deduct physical inline/block edge distances separately from parent radius. This is not composite zero-inset behavior.
Chip trigger opens sibling listbox; chip options deduct popup effective inset once and preserve 4u slots.
